items.title: Shifting trends: Largecap funds returned 9.8% in Oct, smallcaps just 0.7%
items.description: Indian equities staged a strong comeback, with net inflows into largecap funds rising to ₹13,887 crore, even as those into smallcap funds fell to ₹5,152 crore, shows Vallum Capital report

items.title: NFO launch: Nippon India's debt index fund to invest 95% in govt bonds
items.description: Nippon India Mutual Fund's new index fund will invest 95-100% of its assets in state government bonds tracking the Crisil-IBX SDL Index-June 2037, with a minimum investment of ₹1,000.
